Take with ×1.5 reserve, as no rework on the playa.<x4/><x5/><x6/>Two mistakes that kill the work:<x7/><x8/>1. <x9/>Acetic silicone.<x10/> Regular construction sealant releases acetic acid when curing (smells like vinegar) — it corrodes copper traces and contacts. The strip will work, then start dimming in sections after months, and the cause will be elusive. Need <x11/>neutral<x12/> (neutral cure), preferably electronics-grade.<x13/>2. <x14/>Hot glue.<x15/> Gun glue holds up to about 60-70°C, and on the playa, it's 45 in the shade and much more in the sun and black silicone. It will flow during operation — the cap will slide, dust and moisture will get inside.<x16/><x17/><x18/>Steps for each cut:<x19/> cut strictly on the mark (in WS2811 pixel — three diodes, cutting off-mark kills the whole group) → clean and tin contacts → solder wire → fill cap with neutral silicone and fit so silicone protrudes and seals the cut completely → let fully cure (neutral dries longer than acetic, up to a day) → only then test in operation.<x20/><x21/><x22/>What to glue with and why not with a gun.<x23/> Need a small tube at hand, not a cartridge for a gun: about 24 cuts, each a drop, and an open 300 ml tube will dry between sessions. Suitable <x24/>ASI 388 Electronic Grade<x25/> 2.8 oz (~$10) or GE Advanced Silicone 2.8 oz (~$8) — both neutral. Do not take regular clear RTV from auto store: it's usually acetic.<x26/><x27/><x28/>And separately about the glue gun that heats.<x29/> It's not just that regular hot glue flows from heat. The main thing is: <x30/>almost nothing sticks to silicone<x31/> — neither hot glue, nor epoxy, nor superglue. Silicone tube has such a surface that glue just peels off as a film. Only silicone sticks to silicone. Therefore, even high-temperature hot glue (polyamide, holds 120°C) is not an option here — it will withstand the heat but will peel off the tube.<x32/><x33/><x34/>Check caps against the cross-section of your strip<x35/> — they are not universal: there are 6×12, 12×12, 16×16 mm, etc. Buy after measuring the one that has already arrived.

Measurement order: 1) Strip set to solid white 100% — I already set this mode, it's most sensitive to voltage drop. 2) Lower voltage on power supply in grid, wait 15 s at each point. 3) Record current at each point and note color: white / slightly warmer / yellow / orange. 4) Note voltage where white STOPPED being white to the eye — this is the working threshold. 5) Then run animation and go through points again: look for glitches — pixels out of place, flickering, frozen points. Chip powered from 4.5 V, so glitches start BELOW color threshold. 6) Raise voltage back to 12 V and check everything returns on its own, without restart.

Потік біжить від зовнішнього кінця проме: The flow runs from the outer end of the beam to the center and WITHOUT INTERRUPTION goes by turn around the circle to the right — exactly to the base of the next beam. Beam and turn — this is one continuous strip, one sleeve. There is no separate ring: circle 2.14 m consists of eight turns of 0.2675 m, laid end to end. Sleeve = beam 0.95 + turn 0.2675 = 1.2175 m, eight sleeves = 9.74 m. Cut ONLY at the manufacturer's marks and ONLY at the ends of the sleeve — there is no cut inside the sleeve, otherwise the turn will cease to be a continuation of the beam. Round the length UP to the nearest mark, hide the excess down into the groove at the outer end of the beam, so the turn still reaches end to end with the neighbor.

Сітчастий комп'ютерний фільтр тримає час: Mesh computer filter holds particles larger than <x0/>50 µm<x1/>, while playa dust is <x2/>1-10 µm<x3/>. But foam alone is not enough: foam and Outerwears-type covers from desert racing are <x4/>a coarse first stage<x5/>, catching sand and clumps and saving the second from quick clogging. Dust 1-10 µm is stopped only by a final filter of class <x6/>MERV 13<x7/> (85-90% at 1-3 µm) or higher. Standard mat of industrial fans Pfannenberg and Rittal is class G4, only 20-50% at 1-5 µm, not saving by itself. And the main thing about size: resistance grows as the square of speed on the filter, so a large 12×20 inch filter works almost without resistance at our flows and clogs slowly, while a 120 mm patch clogs in days.

У WS2811 на 12 В піксель — це три діоди: In WS2811 at 12 V, a pixel is three diodes in series plus a current-limiting resistor for each color. Red needs about 6 V for the trio, blue and green — up to 9.5 V. Therefore, their reserve is different: when the voltage drops, blue and green suffocate FIRST, and red holds the longest. White turns yellow, then orange. The WS2811 chip itself is powered from 4.5 V, so the animation runs long after the color has shifted — to the eye, everything "works," but white is no longer white.
У WS28xx кожен чіп їсть постійно, навіть: In WS28xx each chip consumes constantly, even when the diode is dark. Not noticeable on a meter, but accumulates on 9.77 m and enters the night budget.

У послідовному ланцюзі один мертвий чип: In a serial chain, one dead chip extinguishes everything after it — up to seven beams. With parallel supply, the beam sees its data independently: if a chip burns out, only the remainder of THAT beam goes dark. Side effect — all 8 beams show the same animation, but for a symmetrical star with "running water" from the center outward, this is exactly what's needed.<x0/><x1/><x2/>2. Each beam is a replaceable module.<x3/> Connector on both sides (3-pin), beam is removed and a new one is installed.

ЦАП — це перекладач з цифри в звук. ESP3: DAC — a translator from digital to sound. ESP32 only understands numbers: it sends a stream of zeros and ones to the DAC via three wires (BCK — bit clock, LCK — frame clock, DIN — data itself). The speaker doesn't understand numbers, it needs voltage that swings smoothly. The DAC converts numbers into such voltage — weak, tenths of a volt. Then the amplifier takes this weak voltage and boosts it to power that moves the diaphragm. Without the DAC, there will be no conversation between ESP32 and the amplifier: one has nothing to listen to, the other has nothing to say.
